name: Greta Varga
headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend engineer focused on building reliable user interfaces, improving product quality, and collaborating closely with design and product teams. Experienced across testing, data-driven features, and accessibility-minded delivery in fast-moving analytics products. Comfortable taking ownership from implementation through release support.

roles.title: Junior Frontend Developer
bullets: Built customer-facing screens with GraphQL, turning mockups into reusable interface flows that reduced rework during handoff.
Created Cypress checks for key journeys and caught regressions before release, improving confidence in the frontend by 30%.
Partnered with designers and product stakeholders to refine interactions and keep delivery aligned with user needs.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
bullets: Delivered new product pages in Vue while working in Agile sprints and coordinating priorities with a cross-functional team of 6.
Expanded Cypress coverage around GraphQL-powered views, which helped the team spot interface issues earlier and reduce hotfixes by 20%.
Refined state handling and component structure in the frontend so the dashboard felt faster and easier to maintain.
Reviewed stories with product and design to keep releases predictable and improve acceptance quality.

roles.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
bullets: Led implementation of new user-facing features in Next.js and JavaScript, aligning delivery with Agile planning and release goals.
Improved interface consistency with HTML/CSS and Redux, simplifying shared state flows across several key screens.
Shaped accessible components and navigation patterns so the product met Web accessibility expectations for keyboard and screen-reader use.
Strengthened automated checks with Jest and Cypress, cutting escaped UI defects by 25% across major releases.
Coached two engineers on frontend reviews and release readiness while keeping the codebase stable during active delivery.
